description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between “Question Popularity” (x-axis, ranging from 5 to 25 with integer tick marks) and three performance metrics — Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment — plotted as separate lines against the “Values” y-axis (ranging from 0.55 to 1.00 in increments of 0.05). The green line with triangle markers, labeled “Confidence,” remains consistently high across all question popularity levels, starting near 0.93 at x=5, peaking around 0.96 at x=10, and stabilizing near 0.97–0.98 from x=18 to x=26. The red line with square markers, labeled “Alignment,” begins at approximately 0.68 at x=5, dips slightly to 0.67, then rises steadily to 0.90 by x=26, showing a generally increasing trend with minor fluctuations. The blue line with circle markers, labeled “Accuracy,” starts at 0.60 at x=5, drops to 0.60 again at x=6, then climbs to 0.75 at x=8, dips to 0.72 at x=14, and rises to 0.88 at x=26, indicating an overall upward trajectory with notable volatility. All three lines show a general positive correlation with question popularity, though Confidence remains highest and most stable, while Accuracy and Alignment exhibit more variation and growth over the range.
